WITH pack_link(cr, pack_id) AS (
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
  UNION
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
sec_link(cr, section_id) AS (
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
  UNION
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
),
doc_pack(doc_id, pack_key, pack_number, tsg_meeting) AS (
  SELECT d.id, cp.id, cp.pack_number, cp.tsg_meeting
  FROM document d
  JOIN pack_link pl ON pl.cr IN (d.id, d.number)
  JOIN cr_pack cp ON pl.pack_id IN (cp.id, cp.pack_number)
),
doc_disp(doc_id, code, wg_meeting) AS (
  SELECT d.id, disp.code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id)
  FROM document d
  JOIN disposition disp ON disp.target IN (d.id, d.number)
  JOIN resolution r ON r.id = disp.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting m ON r.meeting_id IN (m.id, m.label)
  WHERE ((lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) LIKE '%source%verified%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) LIKE '%verified%source%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) = 'verified') AND lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) NOT LIKE '%unverified%' AND lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) NOT LIKE '%not%verified%' AND lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) NOT LIKE '%non%verified%') AND ((lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) LIKE '%whole%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) LIKE '%entire%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) IN ('document','doc','tdoc','full','full_document')) AND lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) NOT LIKE '%part%') AND (m.wg IS NULL OR replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(m.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE '%RAN1%' OR replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(m.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE '%WG1%' OR replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(m.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') IN ('R1','1'))
),
doc_sec(doc_id, spec, release, clause) AS (
  SELECT d.id, COALESCE(s.spec, d.spec), s.release, s.clause
  FROM document d
  JOIN sec_link sl ON sl.cr IN (d.id, d.number)
  JOIN section s ON sl.section_id = s.id
)
SELECT DISTINCT dd.code AS disposition, dd.wg_meeting AS wg_meeting, dp.pack_number AS cr_pack, dp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, ds.clause AS clause
FROM document d
JOIN doc_disp dd ON dd.doc_id = d.id
JOIN doc_pack dp ON dp.doc_id = d.id
JOIN doc_sec ds ON ds.doc_id = d.id
WHERE (d.number = 'R1-2112940' OR d.id = 'R1-2112940')
  AND (ds.spec IS NULL OR replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(ds.spec,'')),'3GPP',''),'TS',''),' ',''),'.',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE '%38212')

  SELECT doc_id FROM start_doc
  UNION
  SELECT d2.id
  FROM chain c
  JOIN document d1 ON d1.id = c.doc_id

  JOIN document d2 ON rv.later IN (d2.id, d2.number)
)

FROM chain c
JOIN document d ON d.id = c.doc_id

JOIN doc_pack dp ON dp.doc_id = d.id
WHERE c.doc_id NOT IN (SELECT doc_id FROM start_doc)

  SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
  UNION
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
),
doc_pack(doc_id, pack_key, pack_number, tsg_meeting) AS (
  SELECT d.id, cp.id, cp.pack_number, cp.tsg_meeting
  FROM document d
  JOIN pack_link pl ON pl.cr IN (d.id, d.number)
  JOIN cr_pack cp ON pl.pack_id IN (cp.id, cp.pack_number)
),
doc_disp(doc_id, code, wg_meeting) AS (
  SELECT d.id, disp.code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id)
  FROM document d
  JOIN disposition disp ON disp.target IN (d.id, d.number)
  JOIN resolution r ON r.id = disp.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting m ON r.meeting_id IN (m.id, m.label)
  WHERE ((lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) LIKE '%source%verified%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) LIKE '%verified%source%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) = 'verified') AND lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) NOT LIKE '%unverified%' AND lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) NOT LIKE '%not%verified%' AND lower(COALESCE(disp.evidence_status,'')) NOT LIKE '%non%verified%') AND ((lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) LIKE '%whole%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) LIKE '%entire%' OR lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) IN ('document','doc','tdoc','full','full_document')) AND lower(COALESCE(disp.scope,'')) NOT LIKE '%part%') AND (m.wg IS NULL OR replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(m.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE '%RAN1%' OR replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(m.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE '%WG1%' OR replace(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(m.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') IN ('R1','1'))
),
doc_sec(doc_id, spec, release, clause) AS (
  SELECT d.id, COALESCE(s.spec, d.spec), s.release, s.clause
  FROM document d
  JOIN sec_link sl ON sl.cr IN (d.id, d.number)
  JOIN section s ON sl.section_id = s.id
)
SELECT DISTINCT dp.pack_number AS cr_pack, dp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM document d
JOIN doc_pack dp ON dp.doc_id = d.id
WHERE (d.number = 'R1-2212754' OR d.id = 'R1-2212754')
